description: Baseline ConstraintSet for Northwind Digital (EU-domiciled merchant, global card volume, floor margin 25 bps).

regulatory.rationale: EU-issued cards are processed by EEA-established acquirers; the processor is an independent controller for our purposes and there is no transfer mechanism we are willing to rely on.

authority.citation: GDPR Art. 44-46; DPA review 2026-08-19, memo NRD-DPA-114
authority.note: Region is read from the acquirer capability catalog, not guessed from the processor's brand.

regulatory.rationale: PSD2/RTS applies to EEA issuers; UK issuers are treated identically by our own policy even though we could argue otherwise post-Brexit.

authority.citation: PSD2 Art. 97; Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/389 Art. 13-18
authority.note: Exemption evidence is #11's analysis; this rule only decides whether the route must be 3DS-capable.

network.rationale: Visa's excessive-reattempt rule: no more than 15 reattempts of a declined transaction in a rolling 30-day window before per-attempt fees apply; category 1 declines may not be reattempted at all.

authority.citation: Visa Core Rules & Product Rules, Excessive Reattempts (eff. April 2022); category codes per Visa decline category framework
authority.note: Counted per card, which is the conservative reading of a rule documented per transaction - see constraints/README.md 'counting keys'.

network.rationale: Category 1 is 'the issuer will never approve' - reattempting it is a fee with no upside, so the card is stopped for this merchant rather than the transaction.
Mastercard merchant advice codes tell us when to try again (MAC 24-30); ignoring a code that says 'do not try again' costs $0.10 per attempt, and ignoring a timed code wastes the attempt.

authority.citation: Mastercard Transaction Processing Excellence, Merchant Advice Codes (MAC 02/03/21/24-30)

budget.rationale: Acquirer-side velocity complaints start at the second authorization attempt on the same card in a day; we cap ourselves below the limit where issuers begin treating our MID as abusive.

relaxable.reason: Peak-season recovery window agreed with the acquirer; reviewed monthly against decline-reason mix.

budget.rationale: Two attempts per transaction. Every additional attempt has to beat the expected-value test on its own; the cap stops a chain from being justified by a chain.
An attempt that is in flight but unconfirmed reserves the card's budget slot; if the result never arrives the lease expires at the deadline so a late authorization cannot double-charge (#10).

mandate.rationale: Above EUR 250 the liability shift is worth more than the friction: chargeback losses on large tickets exceed the measured conversion loss.

authority.note: Business mandate, distinct from the PSD2 rule: it applies to non-EEA cards too.

mandate.rationale: Corporate-card volume is committed to charlie under the 2026 rate agreement; the commitment is measured monthly so a silent fallback is a commercial event.

relaxable.reason: Monthly tolerance when charlie is degraded or out of the corporate-card market for the currency.

mandate.rationale: Echo's MIT re-presentment duplicates attempts on mid-flight retries; excluded from recurring traffic only, which keeps the exclusion auditable and reversible.

econ.rationale: Platform margin floor of 25 bps. Evaluated on take_bps - cost_bps(route), which is the only margin that actually varies by route (ADR-0002 open question, resolved here as the platform reading).

relaxable.reason: Permits a below-floor route when the alternative is a known-hard decline; bounded to a quarter of volume and alerted.

econ.rationale: No route may cost more than 400 bps all-in; the bandit is free to trade margin for auth rate inside this envelope and not outside it.

preference.rationale: Alpha holds the primary commercial agreement and is preferred where its eligible approval rate is within 15 bps of the best; the bandit decides inside that band.
A second tier exists so a preference never makes a request unroutable: if tier 1 is ineligible the tier-2 set is used, and if that is empty the bandit sees every eligible arm.

constraints.rationale: Support re-route of a specific stuck transaction onto delta after a manual reconciliation review.
